messages.content: Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "=====". Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Use exactly 6 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.) End your response with this exact line: "The outer solar system shows us just how inventive life could be.". Avoid these punctuation characters entirely: [';'].

Write a casual blog post about how the outer solar system is different from the inner solar system, and what that means for the possibility of life. Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Every divider line must be exactly: "=====". Make sure all of these punctuation marks appear: [';', ',']. Keep it to 4 paragraphs or fewer. (Make paragraph breaks clear.) The final line of your response must be exactly: "The outer solar system is teaching us how creative life might be.".
